summary: Aurelion Inc., a Hong Kong-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a board committee reshuffle rather than any transactional event. On November 11, 2026, the board approved changes to its nominating and corporate governance committee: Herman Yu ceased serving as member and chair, and Chairman of the Board Chang-Wei Chiu was appointed member and chair effective the same date. No financial terms, advisors, shareholder stakes, or regulatory clocks were disclosed. The filing is a routine governance update incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-3 shelf; no deal terms apply and no risk-arb angle exists.
